title: unified-rollouts-add-quarantine-stage-for-probing-canary
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Context: Our unified rollouts engine supports canary, A/B and shadow strategies but has limited controls for probing stages used by our proactive probing workflows. In some pathological cases probing can accelerate a rollout that should be quarantined (noisy telemetry spikes from synthetic traffic). This PR introduces an explicit 'quarantine' stage between probing and promotion that gates automated promotion when a quorum of probing metrics fail or are flaky.

What this change does:
- Adds a Quarantine stage to the rollout state machine. When a probing stage reports metric quorum failures or high variance, the rollout transitions to quarantine instead of immediate rollback or promotion.
- Implements a configurable quarantine timeout and manual-review flag. Quarantined rollouts pause automated progression and can be either promoted, rolled back, or moved to manual quarantine release by SRE.
- Integrates quarantine signals into the autorollback engine: quarantine now contributes to composite metric decisions and alerting.
- Adds observability: dashboarding metrics, audit logs for quarantine transitions, and a per-rollout quarantine_reason field exposed via API.
- Adds e2e tests (simulated probing noise), unit tests for state transitions, and updated docs for runbooks and operator flows.

Motivation: Probing traffic is invaluable for proactive detection, but it can be brittle (intermittent infra flakiness, noisy third-party endpoints). Previously probed failures triggered immediate rollback which caused churn. Quarantine provides a safer intermediate state for investigation and reduces noisy automatic rollbacks while still surfacing issues to SRE.

Checklist:
- [x] State machine change + implementation
- [x] Autorollback integration
- [x] Observability (metrics/audit logs)
- [x] Unit tests
- [x] E2E tests (simulated probing noise)
- [x] Docs & runbook updates

Related: Linear ENG-1245 (quarantine stage design), ENG-1302 (autorollback composite metrics). Support ticket SUP-4421 reported a production incident where probing flapping caused 3 rollbacks in 24h.

Sofia Ruiz: Found a race on transition when manual unquarantine occurs during automated evaluation; suggested a compare-and-swap guard around state transitions.
Aisha Patel: Implemented CAS guard and added test covering concurrent manual/auto transitions. PTAL.
Dinesh Kumar: Docs and runbook are thorough. One nit: clarify who oncall team is responsible for manual review in the runbook (changed to "rollouts-oncall").
